# Avatar

A person or entity as an image or initials, with an optional presence status. `AvatarGroup` overlaps several with a +N chip.

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- To identify people in lists, comments and headers.
- `AvatarGroup` to show who takes part in something in a small space.

## When not to

- Decorative icons: use the icon itself.
- When people must be reachable one by one: use a list.

## Examples

### Initials and sizes

`name` is required: it is the accessible name and the source of the initials.

```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-4">
  <Avatar name="Camila Pérez" size="sm" />
  <Avatar name="Camila Pérez" />
  <Avatar name="Camila Pérez" size="lg" />
  <Avatar name="Altazor Taller" square />
</div>
```

### Photos

With `src` the photo fills the circle; the name is its alt text. If the photo fails, the initials show instead. Use portraits with the person's permission.

```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-4">
  <Avatar name={camila.name} src={camila.src} size="sm" />
  <Avatar name={luis.name} src={luis.src} />
  <Avatar name={marta.name} src={marta.src} size="lg" />
  <Avatar name={ivan.name} src={ivan.src} status="online" />
</div>
```

### Image that fails to load

A broken `src` shows the initials instead of a broken image.

```tsx
<Avatar name="Luis Ortega" src="/no-existe.jpg" />
```

### Presence status

The dot is announced with its own text, so colour is never the only cue. Use `decorative` when the name is already visible beside it.

```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-4">
  <Avatar name="Camila Pérez" status="online" />
  <Avatar name="Luis Ortega" status="away" />
  <Avatar name="Marta Ríos" status="busy" />
  <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Avatar name="Iván Soto" status="offline" decorative /><span>Iván Soto</span></div>
</div>
```

### Group

Overlapping avatars with a +N chip for the rest.

```tsx
<AvatarGroup people={[...photos, ...people.slice(4)]} max={3} />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` (required) | `string` |  | Required: it is the accessible name and where the initials come from. |
| `src` | `string` |  | Photo. If it fails to load, the initials show instead. |
| `size` | `AvatarSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `square` | `boolean` | `false` | Rounded square instead of a circle, for organisations. |
| `status` | `AvatarStatus` |  | A presence dot. It is spoken in words, so colour is never the only cue. |
| `statusLabel` | `string` |  | Spoken status text. Defaults to the localised label of `status`. |
| `ring` | `boolean` | `false` | A border in the page colour, so overlapping avatars stay apart. Used by `AvatarGroup`. |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `false` | Set when the name is already visible as text next to the avatar, so screen readers don't hear it twice. |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **`name` is required:** it is the accessible name and the source of the initials. Set `decorative` when the name is already visible next to the avatar.
- If `src` fails to load, the initials show instead of a broken image.
- **Status is spoken in words** ("En línea", "Ausente"), so the dot is never the only cue; every dot is 3:1 against its ring.
- In a group each avatar is named and the +N chip reads "2 más".

## Content

- Use the person's full name; initials come from the first two words.
